abstract: Helicopter dynamics system is a strongly coupled multi-variable nonlinear system, and the actual maneuvers in the presence of many uncertain factors. Therefore, in the design of helicopter flight controller, in order to ensure the safety of helicopter flight, improve the efficiency of completing the mission and reduce driver's work burden, it is not enough to make the helicopter for anti-jamming capability, while the internal parameters of the helicopter model perturbations have a strong robustness. This paper describes the mathematical model of a helicopter first, providing a basis for making for the relevant control methods; Then, this article describes the state feedback pole assignment based on decoupling control and robust H∞ control theory's concept and mathematical foundations; Finally, it proposes a design method of robust H∞ controller, designs concrete H∞ controller for the helicopter model specifically, and builds a complete decoupling of robust H∞ control system.

articleTitle: Learner-centered evaluation system of autonomous learning under the platform of E-learning
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: This paper focuses on the learner-centered evaluation system of college English autonomous learning under the platform of E-learning. Students should be the subject of the evaluation process, so that they can learn more about their own strengths and weaknesses. It can motivate them to participate in the autonomous learning process more actively and enthusiastically, and further improve their learning ability.

articleTitle: Application of GIS in the jack mackerel yield data analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: With the development of offshore fishing techniques, fishing intensity increased gradually. The fishery centers of tuna, squid, jack mackerel and other economic fish species are changing rapidly. In order to grasp the fishery center of time and space, and learn the latest changes in fishery resources, in this study, the Chilean jack mackerel yield data is as an example to analyze. Equal space grid, Equal time interval, equal distance range, and other spatial analysis methods are used to analyze. There are some results are obtained, such as the position of fishery center, temporal and spatial distribution of CPUE, comparing the efficiency of fishing boats and other information.

articleTitle: Method of integrating public service data on civil aviation based on information grid
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: According to the specific needs of aero operation and feature of aero public service data, the article aims to analyze the model of integrating flows and adapter on civil aviation which is on the base of information grid as well as to propose comprehensive data and integrated environmental framework on informative grid, so as to provide public and executive of civil aviation with complete, timing and exact message which can afford technical support.

articleTitle: Effectively extracting useful information from complex structured XML databases
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: In this paper, we focus on providing users with an effective and efficient way to extract useful information from complex structured XML databases. We propose a new query mechanism to provide users with the ability to refine the ambiguous semantics of the initiative ATP query before execution, thus we can avoid identifying meaningful answers from large amount of irrelevant results returned by existing methods. We implement algorithms for efficient evaluating an ATP query. Rich experimental results show that our method can be used easily and outperform existing query engines significantly.

articleTitle: Market-Decision Coupling Model based on emissions trading
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: Enterprises play a principle role in the energy conservation and emission reduction. The purpose of establishing emissions trading marketing is to introduce market mechanism to affect the enterprise decision-making behavior, and to bring out the initiative of enterprises to conserve energy and reduce emission. This paper, from the perspective of the micro-economy, based on the thought of integrating economy and management theories, establishes the market with considering the trade of emissions right-decision making model. The paper stared with the market structure and analyzed the interacting and coupling of enterprises' decision making further. So that it laid a foundation for a comprehensive and systematic study of the behaviors of company under the emission trading.

articleTitle: Software documentation writing on the project of software upgrade and maintenance
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: The software documentation is unpopular among many developers at present while the documents are important for the staffs who work for secondary development and software maintenance. For this phenomenon, a teaching method of writing software documentation is proposed in this paper, in which the software maintenance is the driving force to make students fully understand and grasp the method of software documentation writing through an upgrade and maintenance software project. And students learn to write effective software documentation to establish the level and structure of the document.

articleTitle: Review of new technologies in “Green” optical network
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: Though introducing the conception of “green” to optical networks, we discuss three key technologies to enhance the network energy efficiency rate (NEER), including General Multiple Protocols Label Switch (GMPLS), Passive Optical Network (PON), and Network Redundant Element Shutdown (NRES) technology. The optimization and improvement methods as well as the situation of application of the three technologies are analyzed. Then we explore the prospective development of the green optical networks.

articleTitle: Parallel decoupling algorithm for solving the block tri-diagonal linear equations
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: In this paper, the parallel decoupling algorithm is given to solve the block tri-diagonal linear equations. The solution process of the algorithm are as follows: Firstly, decoupling method is used to decompose the huge block tri-diagonal linear equations to even number small block tri-diagonal ones with balancing loadings, and sum of the small blocks tri-diagonal linear equations equals the number of processors in the cluster that are composed of multiple computers. Secondly, the parallel computing model of the single program multiple data is employed to solve each small blocks tri-diagonal linear equations by the pursuit method in each processor. Lastly, the main processor collects the results from different processors and calculates the final solution of the large block tri-diagonal linear equations.

articleTitle: The analysis of comprehensive assessment model based on set pair analysis
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: In recent years, different mathematical models have been used in comprehensive assessment calculation of various industries. This paper focuses on introducing the same-indefinite-contrary systemic assessment model of set pair analysis, which highlights its characteristics as strongly systemic and combination of qualitative and quantitative. In this model, the paper quotes the improved AHP method to calculate the index weight, analyzes the uncertainty of i in the connection degree expression, and dialectically studies the certainty and uncertainty of the information in engineering system. The evaluation steps and algorithm of fuzzy comprehensive evaluation (FCE) are introduced. It aims to emphasize that SPA is more dynamic and open than FCE. The paper refers to the comprehensive evaluation of the students' quality, and the comparison of calculation results show that the SPA model is concise, objective and reasonable.

articleTitle: Implement of intelligent intrinsic safety mode DC UPS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: In view of inefficient charging and discharging management and monitoring in the intrinsic safety mode DC UPS power underground in mining at present, this paper puts forward a three-segments mode charging control strategy for the Lithium-ion battery of UPS using the microcomputer and the method for no discharging while low battery voltage. At the same time, this UPS can transmit the working parameters of its own and its battery. It also provides detailed intrinsic safety circuit with two stages voltage limiting and current limiting by using LM723, and software flow chart of microcontroller. In practice it proves that the service life of the UPS's battery be prolonged and the control center also can in time understand the state of this power.

articleTitle: Study of projectile-loaded Optical-Mechanical-Electrical System against heavy overload
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: Based on inquired into overload, the Optical-Mechanical-Electrical System's working conditions of the projectile-loaded is analyzed, then the scheme to against heavy overload is designed. Finally the model is simulated and the experiments are accomplished. By simulation and experiments, the design in this contribution is proved reasonably and feasibly and could meet the requirements of the projectile weapon well.

articleTitle: The decomposition of complex concepts based on AFS
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: AFS (Axiomatic Fuzzy Set) is a new fuzzy mathematical analysis. Boolean matrices and binary relations are one to one correspondence between some of the properties of the binary relationship can be expressed Boolean matrix and lattice theory and research. In this paper, Boolean relations, Boolean matrices and fuzzy concept lattice theory of the structure of complex studies and research, way to break down complex concepts into simple concept of the method, which is easy to machine identification.

articleTitle: Analysis and processing on abnormal phenomena of momentum wheel of different platform satellite
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: The structure of satellite system is complex and the operating environment is unique. The satellite needs high reliability. According to the characteristic of incomplete information it is very hard to make the fast and accurate judgment for its existent fault. This paper studies two satellite platforms, which are domestic and oversea respectively; with the similar Abnormal phenomena that momentum wheel appeared in the course of in-orbit management as examples, implements the fault location, puts forward solving measures and has given the flow diagram of fault emergency processing in the daily telemetry and telecommand management.

articleTitle: UML modeling based on Extendsim and its application in warship maintenance support
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: Three-echelon maintenance support process of warship is a dynamic and complex process. Combining with the advantages of Extendsim and UML, the UML models of warship maintenance support process were built, which including entity collaboration diagram, class diagram and activity diagrams, and a method of transforming UML models into Extendsim models was proposed. Based on these, warship maintenance support simulation software architecture named MVC (Model-View-Controller) was designed and realized. Finally, by the integration and simulation experiment of a three-echelon maintenance support simulation system of warship, the paper made an analysis of the influence factors on the capability of support system, and the simulation results proved that simulation system can simulate accurately the process of warship maintenance support.

articleTitle: Design of a sample-rate converter based on least-square method
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: A sample-rate converter in digital domain is regarded as filtering the origin signal, and the precision of resampling is mainly decided by filter designing. To improve the accuracy of signal resampling, a resampling realization method is proposed in this paper. It converts a resampling problem into a time-variable filter designing, so the least-square method can be used to obtain the filter coefficients and obtain better accuracy. To avoid the ill-conditioning problem which may arise in solving the least-square equations, QR decomposition based on householder transformation is used. Finally, the experimental results proved that high accuracy signal resampling can be realized with the proposed method.

articleTitle: Study on the application of data mining for customer groups based on the modified ID3 algorithm in the e-commerce
publicationTitle: 2012 International Conference on Computer Science and Information Processing (CSIP)
abstract: Customer information-mining in e-commerce is very important. ID3 algorithm is a mining one based on decision tree, which selects property value with the highest gains as the test attribute of its sample sets, establishes decision-making node, and divides them in turn. ID3 algorithm involves repeated logarithm operation, and it will affect the efficiency of generating decision tree when there are a large number of data, so one must change the selection criteria of data set attributes, using the Taylor formula to transform the algorithm to reduce the amount of data calculation and the generation time of decision trees and thus improve the efficiency of the decision tree classifier. It is shown that the use of improved ID3 algorithm to deal with the customer base data samples can reduce the computational cost, and improve the efficiency of the decision tree generation.
